methods.name: syns.repo
methods.description: The Syns repository of this session's folder, or the placed folder it is, and its head version. The method a page polls with watch: one cheap call.

version.description: The head. null for a repository with no commit yet.

number.description: The head as a number, for display.

holder.description: In a placed folder: OWNER/NAME of the repository holding it. owner, name, role, visibility and fileCount are then the holder's.

path.description: In a placed folder: its path in the holder. Every path a page uses is counted from it.

sharedFolder.description: true in a folder-only collaborator's checkout of a shared folder: the record is the folder's identity, and fileCount is 0.

no_repo.description: The session's folder holds no Syns repository, or the caller is the home page.

no_access.description: The machine's account cannot reach the repository, or is logged out.

not_logged_in.description: No Syns login on that machine: someone runs syns login there.

cli_missing.description: No syns on that machine; an operator installs it or names it in the plugin's settings.

timeout.description: The CLI did not answer in time. Retry a read; after a write, re-read syns.repo first.

folder_out_of_place.description: A placed folder is not at the path its identity file records; an operator moves it back.

bad_scope.description: The scope is outside the session's folder, not a placed folder of its repository where one is needed, or not where the method acts: a folder action at a root, a holder action in a placed folder, a folder's people before it is shared, `scope` on a whole-repository method.

instruction:
**Syns workspace.** When this session's folder is empty or a Syns repository, your page (the one you write every turn) opens inside the repository's workspace. Before your first page in a session:
- No `.page/index.html`: `mkdir -p .page && syns cat .page/index.html --repo bartsoj/syns-workspace-light-template > .page/index.html`
- No `.syns.yaml`: `syns push -n <a short name for this work> --visibility private`. If it asks for `syns login`: run that in the background, give the person the link it prints, and push again once it says `Login successful`.

When something must outlive a turn, make it an app: a folder holding an `index.html` and its data; the workspace runs it with `syns.*` counted from that folder. Read the guide's *Apps in the workspace* before you build one. Your page reports and asks; the app holds the data and does the work. The workspace itself is the repository's `.page/index.html`: change it as the person asks.

**Look.** The design and layout of your page and every app should fit its content and overall design of the workspace.
guide:
# Syns: the session's repository, from a page

## When this applies

Only when the session's folder is a Syns repository, or a folder placed in one. At load, look for `syns.repo` in `context.get` and call it. Absent, or `unavailable` / `no_repo`: say so on the page and keep the rest working. The page never names a repository, session or folder. Never show invented data in its place.

## A placed folder

A folder placed in a repository (a tool) is all the page sees: every `path` counts from it; nothing outside is reachable. A document may also set a scope (`threadPage.setScope`): a placed folder of the session's own repository, holding its own identity file; its calls then answer for that folder alone. `bad_scope` refuses any other. `syns.repo` adds `holder` (OWNER/NAME) and `path`: show those. `owner`, `name`, `role`, `visibility` and `fileCount` are the holder's; build no path or link from them. `version` is the holder's head, so `syns.diff` may list nothing; a write is `stale_head` only if the folder changed after `base`. Writes publish to all who share the holder. `syns.place { template, path }` places a template as a new folder, always at the session's folder.

## Apps in the workspace

An app is a folder holding an `index.html`, its CSS and JS beside it, named relatively. The workspace runs it in a sandboxed frame with its own `threadPage`: `invoke`, `watch`, `scope`. It may call what a Thread Page may, confirmed or granted as there, and `syns.*` but `syns.place` and those of *Sharing and people* other than `syns.users` (`bad_scope`); `storage.*` is its own. Its paths count from its folder; `../` reaches the rest of the session's folder for reading (its CSS and JS links and `syns.*` reads), and its writes stay inside its folder. A `<form>` messages the agent unless the app's script handles the submit. When someone else changes a file in its folder, the app reloads, keeping typed text and scroll; its own saves don't. An app is a page frame: what works on your page works in it.

**Working beside the person.** The app holds the data, in files in its folder; you edit the same files, and your page stays the conversation. After each of your turns the app marks what you changed, where it sits, until the person has seen it (`syns.changes` since the version they last saw, kept in `storage`). A question about a record goes on that record. The app starts you only from its composer, never on an edit, a timer or a load.

## Versions

`version` is a commit id, opaque: compare it, pass it back, show it to nobody. `number` is the same version for display. `blob` changes exactly when a file's content does.

## Loading files

1. `syns.ls { recursive: true }`: every file with its `blob`, and the `version` listed. `truncated: true` means incomplete: list folder by folder.
2. `syns.readMany { paths, version }` in groups of up to 64, passing that `version`; follow `deferred` the same way. `too_large` carries `size` when known (the bound counts the text as JSON escapes it): read it with `syns.read`.

300 files: one `syns.ls` and about five `syns.readMany`, inside the shared 120 calls a minute. A `syns.read` window's lines are joined with `\n`, without `\r` or a final newline: to write a file back exactly, read it with `syns.readMany`.

## Staying current

Poll only `syns.repo`, with the host's `watch`. When its `version` differs from the one held, `syns.changes { since, content: true }` gives each changed path's `status`, text and `by` up to `to.version`; read `deferred` with `syns.readMany` at `to.version`. There is no push.

A page's write has `by.integration` `syns-pages` and `by.trigger` `page`; then `by.run` is the session whose page made it. Others set `by.run` too: never read it alone as a page's.

## Writing

Every file write carries `base`, the `version` last read; the returned `version` is the next `base`. A new file: `syns.write` with `create: true`, which refuses rather than overwrite. `changed: 0`: nothing differed, or the path was gone; no version made. A request past a method's bound comes back from the bridge as `invalid_response`: split it. A picture larger than 720 KiB goes in ordered pieces. Beside texts in one version: `hold: true`, then its `upload` in `syns.commit`.

## Sharing and people

Each method acts where the CLI acts, in the page's own scope. In a placed folder: `syns.shareInfo`, `syns.share`, `syns.unshare`, `syns.folderVisibility`, `syns.enableChecks`. At a repository's root: `syns.repoVisibility`. The collaborator methods act on the scope's people: in a shared placed folder its own (none until shared); at a root the **whole repository's**, so never offer root people for one folder. Elsewhere: `bad_scope`; show controls only where they apply (`syns.repo`'s `holder`, `syns.shareInfo`'s `shared`). Roles are the CLI's; a shared folder takes `read` or `write`.

They act at once, with no dialog, and reach other people. So:

- **Only from a control the reader presses for that action:** never on load, from a timer or `watch`, or chained after another call.
- **The control shows who gets what** before it is pressed: the person and the role, or everyone the folder reaches. `admin` can also share, change visibility and manage people: say so.
- **Public is labelled apart:** "anyone, signed in or not, can find and read this". Never a default; never one option in a list beside private. A public name beginning with a private holder's name shows that name: say so first.
- **`syns.unshare`** removes everyone who reached the folder through it; its name stays reserved.

Poll none of these with `watch`. A refusal with no reason carries the CLI's own words as `message`.

## Every method

The host's roster above (*Registered now*) gives each method's effect, bounds, description and all its reasons. Each line: a method, its params → its result. `path` counts from the repository's root or the placed folder, `/`-separated, at most 1,024 characters; no leading `/` or `-`, no `\` or control character, no `.` or `..` segment. A `?` marks an optional key; a bare `version` or `path` key has that type, `base` is a `version`, `number` an int, `message` a str(≤500); no other key is accepted but `scope`, a folder paths and answers then count from. `…by` is `{ integration: str|null, run: str|null, trigger: str|null }`. `…collaborator` is `{ user?: { id: str, username?: str|null, name?: str|null, email?: str|null, image?: str|null }, role?: str, createdAt?: str|null }`. `…record` is `{ owner?: str, name?: str, visibility?: str, role?: str|null, sharedFolder?: bool, status?: str, description?: str|null, heldIn?: { owner?: str, name?: str, path?: str }|null }`.

- `syns.repo` `{}` → `{ owner: str, name: str, version: version|null, number?: int|null, role: str|null, visibility: str, fileCount: int, holder?: str, path?: str, sharedFolder?: bool }`
- `syns.whoami` `{}` → `{ id: str, username: str, emailVerified: bool|null, name: str|null, email: str|null, image: str|null, bio: str|null, company: str|null, location: str|null, pronouns: str|null, timeZone: str|null, createdAt: str|null, updatedAt: str|null }`
- `syns.ls` `{ path?, recursive?: bool, version?, offset?: int(0–…), limit?: int(1–9000), format?: "lines" }` → `{ version, number, truncated: bool, total: int, nextOffset: int|null, entries?: [{ path: str, type: "file"|"dir", size: int|null, blob: str|null }], lines?: [str] }`
- `syns.readMany` `{ paths: [path] (1–64), version? }` → `{ version, files: [{ path: str, text?: str, size?: int, blob?: str|null, error?: "not_found"|"too_large"|"not_text" }], deferred: [str] }`
- `syns.history` `{ path?, limit?: int(1–100), offset?: int(0–…) }` → `{ total: int, entries: [{ version, number, parent: version|null, author: str|null, at: str, message: str, paths: [str] (0–200), pathsTruncated: bool, by: { …by } }] }`
- `syns.commit` `{ base, message?, files?: [{ path, text?: str(≤1048576), base64?: str(≤983040), upload?: str(≤64) }] (0–64), deletions?: [path] (0–64) }` → `{ version, number, changed: int }`
- `syns.read` `{ path, version?, offset?: int(1–…), limit?: int(1–5000), fit?: bool }` → `{ version, number, path: str, text: str, offset: int, limit: int, totalLines: int, size: int, blob: str }`
- `syns.glob` `{ pattern: str(≤512), path?, version?, offset?: int(0–…), limit?: int(1–2000) }` → `{ version, number, truncated: bool, total: int, nextOffset: int|null, matches: [{ path: str, size: int, blob: str }] }`
- `syns.grep` `{ pattern: str(≤512), path?, glob?: [str(≤512)] (0–8), ignoreCase?: bool, context?: int(0–10), output?: "content"|"files"|"count", headLimit?: int(1–1000), offset?: int(0–…), version? }` → `{ version, number, output: "content"|"files"|"count", truncated: bool, nextOffset: int|null, skipped: [{ path: str, reason: str }], matches?: [{ path: str, line: int, text: str, context: [{ line: int, text: str }] }], files?: [str], counts?: [{ path: str, count: int }] }`
- `syns.diff` `{ from: version, to?: version, patch?: bool }` → `{ from: { version, number }, to: { version, number }, files: [{ path: str, status: str, oldPath?: str, patch?: str }] }`
- `syns.changes` `{ since: version, to?: version, path?, content?: bool }` → `{ from: { version, number }, to: { version, number }, entries: [{ path: str, status: str, oldPath?: str, blob: str|null, size?: int, text?: str|null, by: { …by, number, author: str|null }|null }], deferred: [str] }`
- `syns.write` `{ path, text: str(≤1048576), base, message?, create?: bool }` → `{ version, number }`
- `syns.edit` `{ path, old: str(≤32768), new: str(≤32768), replaceAll?: bool, base, message? }` → `{ version, number, changed: int }`
- `syns.rm` `{ path, base, message? }` → `{ version, number, changed: int }`
- `syns.move` / `syns.copy` `{ from: path, to: path, base, message? }` → `{ version, number, from: str, to: str, files: int }`
- `syns.revert` `{ path, to: version, base, message? }` → `{ version, number }`
- `syns.readBinary` `{ path, version?, offset?: int(0–26214400) }` → `{ version, number, path: str, size: int, blob: str, mediaType: str|null, sha256: str(≤64), offset: int, base64: str, nextOffset: int|null }`
- `syns.writeBinary` `{ path, base64: str(≤983040), base, message?, offset?: int(0–26214400), size?: int(0–52428800), sha256?: str(≤64), hold?: bool }` → `{ complete: bool, received: int, version?, number?, changed?: int, upload?: str(≤64) }`
- `syns.place` `{ template: str(≤201), path, version?: int(1–…) }` → `{ path: str, holder: str, template: { repo: str, version: int, sha: str }, version, number, checks: [str], enableChecks: str|null }`
- `syns.shareInfo` `{}` → `{ …record, holder: str, path: str, holderRole?: str|null, shared: bool, offeredName?: str }`
- `syns.share` `{ name?: str(≤100) }` → `{ …record, holder: str, path: str, created: bool }`
- `syns.unshare` `{}` → `{ owner: str, name: str, holder: str, path: str, unshared: bool, retired?: bool|null }`
- `syns.folderVisibility` `{ visibility: "public"|"private", name?: str(≤100) }` → `{ …record, holder: str, path: str, created?: bool }`
- `syns.repoVisibility` `{ visibility: "public"|"private" }` → `{ …record }`
- `syns.collaborators` `{ limit?: int(1–100), offset?: int(0–…) }` → `{ total: int, limit?: int, offset?: int, data: [{ …collaborator }] }`
- `syns.collaboratorAdd` `{ user: str(≤320), role: "admin"|"write"|"read" }` → `{ added: bool, target: str, role: str }`
- `syns.collaboratorRole` `{ id: str(≤128), role: "admin"|"write"|"read" }` → `{ …collaborator }`
- `syns.collaboratorRemove` `{ id: str(≤128) }` → `{ removed: bool, userId: str }`
- `syns.enableChecks` `{}` → `{ holder: str, path: str, enabled: [str], version?, number? }`
- `syns.explore` `{ query?: str(≤200), tags?: [str(≤100)] (0–8), status?: "active"|"draft"|"completed"|"abandoned", limit?: int(1–100), offset?: int(0–…) }` → `{ total: int, limit?: int, offset?: int, data: [{ owner: str, name: str, description?: str|null, tags?: [str], status?: str|null, visibility?: str, fileCount?: int, forkCount?: int, updatedAt?: str|null }] }`
- `syns.users` `{ query: str(≤100), limit?: int(1–100) }` → `{ data: [{ id: str, username: str, name?: str|null, image?: str|null }] }`

## Errors

Branch on `reason` when there is one, else on `code`. `message` may be shown to the reader.

`unavailable`: not now or not here.
- `no_repo` — The session's folder holds no Syns repository, or the caller is the home page.
- `no_access` — The machine's account cannot reach the repository, or is logged out.
- `not_logged_in` — No Syns login on that machine: someone runs syns login there.
- `cli_missing` — No syns on that machine; an operator installs it or names it in the plugin's settings.
- `timeout` — The CLI did not answer in time. Retry a read; after a write, re-read syns.repo first.
- `folder_out_of_place` — A placed folder is not at the path its identity file records; an operator moves it back.
- `folder_write_unsupported` — The server is too old for writes in a placed folder. Nothing written; reads work.
- `not_permitted` — Syns answered 403: a role too low, or a server limit; the CLI says no more.

`conflict`: re-read.
- `stale_head` — The repository, or placed folder, changed after base; nothing written; detail.current is the head. syns.changes { since: base } says what changed; never retry blindly.
- `checkout_dirty` — The session's folder has unpublished edits, usually its agent mid-turn. Nothing written; retry when syns.repo's version moves.
- `bad_offset` — Send the piece at detail.expected; 0 means start again (pieces or an upload are dropped after a minute).
- `exists` — create's path, or a move's or copy's to, exists at base.
- `occupied` — path already holds a file at the head or on disk; choose another.
- `name_taken` — Another repository holds name; offer the reader another.
- `already_collaborator` — user already holds a grant here; nothing changed.

`invalid_params`: fix the page; with no reason, the params do not fit the method.
- `bad_scope` — The scope is outside the session's folder, not a placed folder of its repository where one is needed, or not where the method acts: a folder action at a root, a holder action in a placed folder, a folder's people before it is shared, `scope` on a whole-repository method.
- `invalid_change` — A path named twice across files and deletions, or no change at all.
- `bad_pattern` — The regular expression or glob does not parse.
- `no_match` — old occurs nowhere in the file.
- `many_matches` — old occurs detail.count times and replaceAll is not set.
- `bad_hash` — The gathered bytes do not match sha256; nothing published.
- `too_large` — Past detail.max bytes, the most one file may hold (25 MiB).
- `bad_name` — name breaks the repository-name rule.

`not_found`: it is not there; with no reason, the path, the `version`, or what was named.
- `no_such_template` — template is no repository the reader can read.
- `no_such_user` — user names nobody on Syns.

`response_too_large`: ask for less. `handler_error`: anything else; `message` holds the CLI's own words when it gave some.

## What a page cannot do here

Choose a repository, or reach outside its scope. Read unpublished edits. Write a file without a `base`. Set a commit's provenance. Run any CLI command but the ones behind these methods: no login, upgrade, push, pull, sync, delete or fork.
